description: A 3D skydiving simulation and stunt game. The player is a competitive skydiver who exits a Cessna Caravan on a jump run, freefalls through open sky in a formation with three AI skydivers, deploys the parachute canopy at the critical moment, and steers the canopy to a precision landing pad. A pull-altitude alarm sounds at 1500m, the hard-deck is 600m, and the reserve auto-deploys below 300m. A wingsuit mode allows sustained glide along cliff faces before chute deployment.

scene_specs.name: ColoradoFreefall
scene_specs.description: Open Rocky Mountain jump, blue-sky daylight, formation objective from aircraft exit down to the landing pad.

scripts.name: FreefallController
scripts.description: 6-axis body attitude control in freefall: barrel rolls, tracking dives, delta position, flare; drag scaling with body angle; terminal velocity plateau; altitude HUD readout.

scripts.name: ParachuteSystem
scripts.description: Canopy deployment at a configurable altitude, inflation physics, left/right steering risers, flare brake for a precision landing.

scripts.name: AltimeterManager
scripts.description: Real-time altitude from aircraft exit to ground; pull-altitude alarm at 1500m, hard-deck at 600m, emergency auto-deploy below 300m.

scripts.name: FormationAI
scripts.description: AI skydivers fly intercept curves to player-relative formation slots and break off on the pull signal.

scripts.name: GameManager
scripts.description: State machine: Menu / Aircraft / Freefall / Canopy / Landed / Crashed / Victory. Score is precision landing distance plus formation time.

story_beats.label: First Jump
story_beats.description: Tutorial descent with a radio coach under a calm clear sky.

story_beats.label: Formation Lock
story_beats.description: All four team members reach the formation diamond in freefall.

missions.title: Precision Landing
missions.description: Exit the aircraft, hold the formation, deploy the canopy above the hard deck and touch down on the landing pad.

objectives.description: Reach the formation diamond in freefall
Land on the precision landing pad

entities.name: FormationDivers

entities.name: CessnaCaravan

entities.name: FormationTarget
